title: A Generative Grammar Underlying the Voynich Manuscript, the Pastiche Hypothesis: Evidence from Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.20835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: The Voynich Manuscript is a fifteenth-century codex written in an unknown script whose content remains undeciphered. Previous studies suggest that its statistical properties resemble those of natural languages, while its illustrations - primarily plants - recall medieval herbals.   Methods: We present a multidisciplinary analysis combining probabilistic modeling, phonetic decomposition, rare-event detection, and multimodal image analysis, based on a newly transliterated corpus. Word- and letter-level distributions are modeled using position-dependent probabilistic grammars, while phonetic patterns are compared across Indo-European, Semitic, and Asian languages. Image-text alignment methods based on large language models are applied to identify potential botanical correspondences.   Results: The results indicate that Voynich symbols behave as letters rather than syllabic units, while word-length distributions resemble syllabic

translated_title: 《伏尼契手稿背后的生成语法与仿作假说：来自大语言模型的证据》
translated_abstract: 背景：伏尼契手稿是一部十五世纪的抄本，以一种未知文字书写，其内容至今尚未被破译。以往研究表明，其统计特性与自然语言相似，而其插图——主要为植物——则令人联想到中世纪的草药书。方法：基于一个新转写的语料库，我们提出了一项结合概率建模、语音分解、稀有事件检测和多模态图像分析的多学科分析。词级和字母级分布采用位置依赖的概率文法进行建模，同时将语音模式与印欧语系、闪米特语系及亚洲语言进行比较。基于大语言模型的图文对齐方法被应用于识别潜在的植物学对应关系。结果：结果表明，伏尼契符号表现为字母而非音节单位，而词长分布则类似于音节（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究综合概率建模、语音分解与基于大语言模型的图文对齐等多学科方法，发现伏尼契手稿符号表现为字母而非音节单位，为手稿可能是模仿自然语言特征而造的“仿作”假说提供了证据。
en_tdlr: Through multidisciplinary analysis combining probabilistic modeling, phonetic decomposition, and LLM-based image-text alignment, this study finds that Voynich symbols behave as letters rather than syllabic units, providing evidence for the pastiche hypothesis that the manuscript may be an imitation of natural language.
